name: zzokzzok
description: 쪽쪽 — 아기 수유 시간 기록 & 다음 맘마 알림 앱 (PWA)

scripts.android:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && mkdir -p release && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk release/zzokzzok-debug.apk && echo 'APK: release/zzokzzok-debug.apk'
scripts.android:release: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease assembleRelease && cd .. && mkdir -p release && V=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && cp android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab release/zzokzzok-$V.aab && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk release/zzokzzok-$V-release.apk && ls -la release
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
